description: Fork of exp670 (1.4569 @ 86.5M, nh=4 winner). Two changes: out_input_nap 6 -> 5 AND v_input_nap 6 -> 5 (K=64 -> 32 in both modules). Per-layer params halved: out_proj 6.29M -> 3.15M (-3.15M/layer), v_lut 3.15M -> 1.57M (-1.57M/layer). Total: 86.5M -> ~58.2M (-28.3M). NOT param-matched. Hypothesis: at bs=16, K=32 doubles per-row gradient updates (each row visited 2x more often than K=64); better-trained rows may compensate for capacity loss. Reference: exp670 = 1.4569 (target = quality match at much smaller params). qk_lut, out_proj heads, all else unchanged from exp670.
